title: GST return turnover limits
description: The turnover and value limits, for tax periods from January 2021, that decide who may furnish returns every quarter (QRMP), the most the invoice furnishing facility carries in a month and who must furnish GSTR-9C, each with its test in the words of its instrument.

instruments: Notification No. 82/2020-Central Tax, 10 November 2020, Central Goods and Services Tax (Thirteenth Amendment) Rules, 2020, rules 59 and 61A
Notification No. 30/2021-Central Tax, 30 July 2021, substituting rule 80 from 1 August 2021

cells.name: Quarterly returns (QRMP): who may choose them
cells.test: having an aggregate turnover of up to five crore rupees in the preceding financial year

rows.source: Notification No. 84/2020-Central Tax, paragraph (2), and Central Goods and Services Tax Rules, 2017, rule 61A(2)

cells.name: Quarterly returns (QRMP): who must leave them
cells.test: A registered person whose aggregate turnover crosses five crore rupees during a quarter in a financial year shall not be eligible for furnishing of return on quarterly basis from the first month of the succeeding quarter.

rows.source: Central Goods and Services Tax Rules, 2017, rule 59(2), as substituted by Notification No. 82/2020-Central Tax

cells.name: Invoice furnishing facility (IFF): the most in a month
cells.test: for the first and second months of a quarter, up to a cumulative value of fifty lakh rupees in each of the months

rows.source: Central Goods and Services Tax Rules, 2017, rule 80(3), as substituted by Notification No. 30/2021-Central Tax

cells.name: Reconciliation statement (GSTR-9C): who must furnish it
cells.test: whose aggregate turnover during a financial year exceeds five crore rupees, shall also furnish a self-certified reconciliation statement as specified under section 44 in FORM GSTR-9C
